map.是。t=√(2h/g) 与 h=½gt² 互为变形，已知其一可求另一。: Yes. t = sqrt(2h/g) and h = 1/2*g*t^2 are rearrangements of each other, so knowing one gives the other.
map.为什么距离与时间的平方成正比？: Why is distance proportional to the square of time?
map.因为物体边落边加速，后一秒的速度总比前一秒快，累积位移就越拉越大。时间翻倍时距离: Because the object accelerates as it falls, the speed in each later second is always greater than in the previous one, so accumulated displacement grows ever larger. When time doubles, distance becomes 4 times (not 2 times); this quadratic relation is also why slightly higher speed greatly increases braking distance in traffic accidents.
